title: PSG & Visit Rwanda Extend Partnership to 2028
text:
Great news for fans of Paris Saint-Germain and those interested in Rwandan tourism: the partnership between PSG and Visit Rwanda has been extended through 2028! This article delves into how this ongoing collaboration aims to boost Rwanda’s global presence and support youth development initiatives. Read on to discover the key highlights of this exciting partnership and what it means for the future of Visit rwanda .
Paris Saint-Germain and Rwanda Extend Partnership Through 2028 Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) and Visit Rwanda have announced the renewal of their partnership, extending their collaboration through 2028. This agreement builds upon the success of their initial alliance, launched in 2019, and aims to further Rwanda’s global presence as a hub for youth progress, creativity, and economic prospect.
Key Highlights of the Renewed Partnership Extended Collaboration: The partnership between PSG and Visit Rwanda will continue through 2028. Global Visibility: Rwanda will gain increased visibility through branding on PSG’s U.S. and Canada-based academies training kits. FIFA club World Cup: The Visit Rwanda logo will appear on the sleeve of the Paris Saint-germain men’s first team jersey at the FIFA Club World Cup in 2025. Youth Development: Continued investment in the PSG Academy Rwanda, which has already provided elite football training, education, and mentorship to over 400 young Rwandans. Rwanda’s Perspective Jean-Guy Afrika , CEO of the Rwanda Development Board , emphasized the significance of the partnership:
This partnership has contributed substantially to positioning Rwanda as a leading destination for tourism and investment—and a beacon for talent, sports, and cultural innovation. Renewing through 2028 allows us to build on that success and create even more impact for Rwandans and the global Paris saint-Germain community.
Jean-Guy Afrika, CEO, Rwanda Development Board
Since the partnership began, millions of fans worldwide have discovered Rwanda through immersive storytelling, broadcast visibility, and unique fan experiences. The collaboration has connected global audiences to Rwanda’s rich culture, nature, and warmth, from matchday features at Parc des princes to the serving of Rwandan coffee to supporters in Paris.
Investment in Youth A central focus of the partnership is a shared commitment to youth development. The PSG Academy Rwanda has been instrumental in providing opportunities for young Rwandans.
Elite Training: Over 400 young Rwandans have received elite football training. Education and Mentorship: The academy provides education and mentorship programs. International Recognition: In 2022, Rwanda’s U13 academy team won the Paris Saint-Germain Academy World Cup. This victory showcased the nation’s rising talent and the impact of long-term investment in young people.
Paris Saint-Germain’s Viewpoint Victoriano Melero,CEO of Paris Saint-Germain,expressed enthusiasm for the continued collaboration:
We are looking forward to continuing this journey with Visit Rwanda. Together,we help showcase the cultural richness and natural beauty of Rwanda,while demonstrating that football can inspire and bring communities around the world closer together.
Victoriano Melero, CEO, Paris Saint-Germain
A Shared Vision for the Future Since 2019, PSG and Visit Rwanda have collaborated to highlight Rwanda’s natural beauty, cultural richness, and dynamic vision for the future, while fostering community through sport. The renewed partnership aims to further celebrate Rwanda as a unique and welcoming destination, where tourism and local engagement are intertwined.

About Visit Rwanda visit Rwanda is the tourism-focused arm of the Rwanda Development Board, responsible for accelerating Rwanda’s economic development by enabling private sector growth. Visit Rwanda collaborates with local conservation, tourism, and development partners to create tourism products that benefit inbound tourists, local communities, and wildlife ecosystems.
